title: Same money: Rolex Explorer 40 or Omega Speedmaster Moonwatch?
why: Prices and photos are already verified in watch-wire-engine/library (run photo.js find "<ref>"; each match has price, source page and date): Rolex Explorer 40 224270 $8,350 vs Omega Speedmaster Moonwatch 310.30.42.50.01.002 $9,000 (7.8% apart). A-wyr with both prices, then one A-photo each. US retail, Nov 2026.

hard_gate_failures: Gate 2: the Rolex price of $8,350 (B.C. Clark) was never re-confirmed; the draft's own notes say the product page returned HTTP 429 twice and the dealer status was not checked.

Gate 6: the draft's notes list unmet layout fixes on slides 1-4 (SAME MONEY tag position, slide 2 cards and margins, shared footer on slides 3-4). I did not view the previews because the review budget ran out, so this rests on the draft's own notes.
Gate 8: caption says 'Images: Rolex, Omega' with no per-photo credit check done.
fixes: slide 3: re-check the $8,350 Rolex Explorer 40 price on the B.C. Clark page, or confirm an official Rolex or Omega source; if not confirmed, relabel as 'retailer price' with date.
slide 1: move the SAME MONEY tag so the headline block sits centred and balanced.
slide 2: keep the cards top-aligned with even side margins and keep the vote line clear of the footer.
slides 3-4: give each slide its own source line instead of one shared 'Source: B.C. Clark, OMEGA' footer.
Re-run the validate check and show a PASS before resubmitting.
verdict.reason: The Rolex price is still unconfirmed and the layout fixes from the last revision are not done. Fix the price source and the layout, then resubmit; I did not review the previews because the budget ran out.
